comment: In every list pairing the three core terminologies, LOINC consistently appears last (“SNOMED CT, ICD-11, LOINC” or “ICD-11, SNOMED CT, LOINC”). Combined with the LOINC-as-downstream-example pattern noted in Comment 4, this may cumulatively read as treating LOINC as secondary.

reviewer.name: Marjorie Rallins, DPM, MS, Executive Director, Health Data Standards
reviewer.organisation: Regenstrief Institute, Health Data Standards, LOINC/UCUM

citation.section: General – ordering convention throughout the document

public.text: In every list pairing the three core terminologies, LOINC consistently appears last (“SNOMED CT, ICD-11, LOINC” or “ICD-11, SNOMED CT, LOINC”). Combined with the LOINC-as-downstream-example pattern noted in Comment 4, this may cumulatively read as treating LOINC as secondary.
public.suggestedRevision: No substantive change needed; noted for awareness. Varying the ordering in a future revision or stating explicitly that no priority is implied by list order, would remove any ambiguity.
